warnings: Ligands are retained with their bound heavy-atom coordinates. Preparation assigns a recorded fixed protonation state and GAFF2 / AM1-BCC parameters for explicit-water OpenMM dynamics.
Retained ions use declared monatomic charge states and require explicit TIP3P water; coordination energetics and alternate oxidation states are not modeled.
A long backbone connection is present. Unresolved internal gaps must be repaired before force-field preparation or simulation; a stretched inferred peptide bond is not accepted.
pH assignment uses OpenMM template/heuristic protonation and histidine tautomer rules, not a pKa calculation or constant-pH simulation.

ligands.protonation_method: Dimorphite-DL 2 empirical site rules at requested pH, pKa precision=0; amide/N–N sites retained from source; original graph/stereotags preserved; no microscopic pKa or tautomer ranking
warnings: Ligand protonation is a fixed model choice; it is not a binding-site pKa calculation or a tautomer ranking.
